description: This file defines the EmployeeEducation entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing employee education records in the database using Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties such as institute, major, year, score, start date, and end date, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: Doctrine entity class representing employee education details, with ORM mapping annotations and basic accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the education record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the education record.

methods.name: setEducation
methods.description: Associates an Education entity with this employee education record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this education record.

methods.name: getInstitute
methods.description: Returns the name of the institute.

methods.name: setInstitute
methods.description: Sets the name of the institute.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Returns the year of graduation or study.

methods.name: setYear
methods.description: Sets the year of graduation or study.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the education period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the education period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the education period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the education period.
